prompt.text:
Implement a complete CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createGlossary }`. `createGlossary(entries)` accepts an array of records shaped as `{ term, categories }`. `term` must be a nonempty trimmed string. `categories` must be an array of nonempty trimmed strings. Terms are unique under case-insensitive comparison; duplicates must throw `Error("Duplicate term: <term>")`. Malformed arguments or records throw `TypeError`. Preserve entry order and category order.

Return an object with `review(tokens)`. `tokens` must be an array of strings or `review` throws `TypeError`. It returns one result per token, in input order, shaped as `{ token, known, canonical, categories }`. Matching is case-insensitive. A known token uses the glossary's trimmed spelling as `canonical` and a copied category array. An unknown token has `canonical: null` and an empty category array. Empty-string tokens are unknown. The glossary must copy all inputs and outputs so later mutation cannot change its behavior.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
